description: This file defines the 'BankingService' interface in a banking application. It declares methods for managing customers, accounts, transactions, and transfers, using domain objects and response entities.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: Interface defining banking operations such as customer management, account handling, and transaction processing.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer to the system.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds customer details by their customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates customer information based on provided details and customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer using their customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds account information by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a transfer transaction between accounts.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for a specific account.
